title: CondRelBench: A Mixed-Domain Benchmark for Condition-Scoped Relation Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.18620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relation extraction systems often identify what a relation is, but not the condition under which it holds. This can collapse condition-bound claims into unsupported generalizations, a failure we call relation overgeneralization. We introduce CondRelBench, a mixed-domain benchmark for evaluating condition-scoped relation understanding. Each claim is represented as (E1, R, E2 | C), where C is the condition licensing the relation. Using 3,000 synthetic paragraphs, 200 PubMed full-text papers, and 695 Reddit posts, we construct five probe variants per tuple that preserve, replace, remove, or contradict the condition, or contradict the relation itself. Models classify each probe as Supported, Not Supported, or Not Enough Evidence. We also introduce Overgeneralization Rate (OGR) and Scope Preservation Score (SPS) to measure false support for altered claims and consistency across probe families. translated_title: CondRelBench：一个面向条件限定关系理解的混合领域基准
translated_abstract: 关系抽取系统通常能识别关系是什么，但无法识别该关系在什么条件下成立。这会导致受条件约束的论断被坍缩为缺乏支撑的泛化结论，我们将这种失败称为“关系过度泛化”。我们提出了CondRelBench，一个用于评估条件限定关系理解的混合领域基准。每个论断被表示为(E1, R, E2 | C)的形式，其中C是使该关系成立的条件。我们使用3,000个合成段落、200篇PubMed全文论文和695条Reddit帖子，为每个元组构建了五种探测变体，分别保留、替换、删除或矛盾化该条件，或矛盾化关系本身。模型需将每个探测样本分类为“支持”、“不支持”或“证据不足”。我们还引入了过度泛化率和范围保持分数两个指标，用于衡量对被篡改论断的错误支持程度以及探测家族之间的一致性。在提示式LLM、微调LLM和编码器模
tldr: 该论文提出混合领域基准CondRelBench，通过五类条件探测变体及OGR、SPS两个新指标，系统评估模型能否理解关系成立的条件范围，以防止“关系过度泛化”问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CondRelBench, a mixed-domain benchmark with five condition-probe variants and two novel metrics (OGR and SPS) to systematically evaluate whether models understand the condition scope under which relations hold, addressing the problem of relation overgeneralization.
